subject.title: feat(cli): add `agents` and `<agent> models` runtime discovery commands

question: Should `acpx` reserve the generic `agents` and `models` positional tokens globally, or must those tokens remain available to the documented raw-agent-command fallback?
rationale: This is a durable CLI parsing and compatibility contract; a mechanical patch cannot determine whether breaking raw invocations is an acceptable product tradeoff.

options.title: Preserve raw-agent compatibility
options.body: Move discovery behind an unambiguous command surface or otherwise retain raw adapter invocation for these tokens, then add compatibility coverage.

options.title: Adopt global reservations
options.body: Approve `agents` and `models` as permanently reserved verbs and explicitly document the raw-adapter breaking change and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve raw-agent compatibility
recommendation.body: Move discovery behind an unambiguous command surface or otherwise retain raw adapter invocation for these tokens, then add compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the repository-wide CLI surface and compatibility policy rather than a localized implementation detail.
